post.description:
Log out the current session.

Bearer JWTs are stateless, so logout is client-side (drop the token). The
web app also clears its cookie. A server-side token denylist / opaque-session
revocation is a B-series follow-up (threat-model §4.2: session invalidation
on password change / MFA enable). We clear the session cookie defensively.

Send a password-reset email if the address is registered.

ALWAYS returns 204 regardless of whether the address is known — this prevents
user enumeration (doc 08 §3.1, threat-model §4.2). The email is only sent
when the user actually exists.

Emits ``auth.password_reset.requested`` on the in-process event bus for audit
(B9 will persist it).

Validate a reset token, set a new password, and consume the token.

Returns ``400`` if the token is unknown, expired, or already used.
On success all other pending reset tokens for this user are also invalidated,
preventing replay of old links.

Emits ``auth.password_reset.completed`` on the in-process event bus for audit
(B9 will persist it).

Demonstration of the ``require_feature`` + ``require_within_limit`` dependency pattern (N2 + N4). Returns 402 when the plan lacks ``smart_search``; returns 429 when the monthly smart-search quota is exhausted. Returns the workspace's metered usage for the current billing month (calendar month, UTC), broken down by dimension, alongside the plan cap for each dimension (``null`` = unlimited). The ``seats`` dimension is refreshed on every call (live count from ``accounts_member``). All other dimensions reflect the accumulated counters in ``billing_usage``.

Clients use this to render usage meters and upgrade CTAs. For the enforcement state (ok|warning|exceeded) used to drive the soft-limit banner, see ``GET /billing/limits`` (N4).

Each dimension carries a ``state`` of ``ok`` (< 80%), ``warning`` (≥ 80%, soft banner), or ``exceeded`` (≥ 100%, hard 429 enforcement + paywall CTA). The ``seats`` dimension is refreshed live on every call. Clients drive the soft-limit banner and paywall prompt from this endpoint (N4).

post.summary: Report a contact as invalid / bounced (C6)
post.description:
Record a workspace-scoped correction report for a contact.

This endpoint is behind ``require_workspace`` (via :data:`RequireMember`):
- The ``X-Workspace-Id`` header (or ``last_active_workspace_id`` fallback) must
  identify the caller's workspace.
- The caller must be at least a ``member`` in that workspace.

On success:
- A new :class:`~contacts.models.ContactCorrection` audit row is inserted.
- The contact's ``status`` is set to ``"bounced"`` or ``"invalid"``.
- ``verified`` is cleared; ``confidence`` is lowered; ``reported_invalid_at``
  and ``bounce_count`` are updated.
- The updated contact + new correction row are returned with HTTP 201.

Calling this endpoint multiple times is safe (idempotent-friendly): each call
appends an audit row and further lowers confidence. The contact status does not
change again if it is already ``"bounced"``/``"invalid"``.

ApiTokenCreate.title: ApiTokenCreate
ApiTokenCreate.description:
Body for creating a workspace or personal API token (doc 08 §1.3).

``scopes`` is validated against the catalog in ``auth.services`` server-side;
an empty list yields a token that can authenticate but pass no scope gate
(useful for an identity-only token). ``expires_at`` is optional (doc 08
§1.3). ``name`` is a human label like ``"Salesforce push"``.

ApiTokenCreated.title: ApiTokenCreated
ApiTokenCreated.description:
Create response — :class:`ApiTokenOut` plus the cleartext secret.

The ``token`` field is the **only** time the plaintext secret is returned
("revealed once", doc 08 §3.6 webhook-secret pattern / §1.3); it is never
retrievable again and is omitted from every list/get response.

ApiTokenList.title: ApiTokenList
ApiTokenList.description: A list of API token metadata (no secrets).

ApiTokenOut.title: ApiTokenOut
ApiTokenOut.description:
Public metadata for an API token — never includes the secret (doc 08 §1.3).

Returned by list endpoints and the non-secret part of create. ``token_prefix``
is a non-secret display fragment (``cs_pat_a1b2``). ``revoked`` /
``last_used_at`` / ``expires_at`` support the hygiene UI.

ApiTokenScopesOut.title: ApiTokenScopesOut
ApiTokenScopesOut.description: The catalog of grantable scopes (for the management UI to render).

ApiTokenType.title: ApiTokenType
ApiTokenType.description:
Whether a token is bound to one workspace or acts as the whole user (B8).

- ``workspace`` — a server-to-server integration token scoped to exactly one
  workspace (doc 08 §1.3 ``cs_live_``/``cs_test_``). Issuing/revoking is an
  *admin* capability in that workspace.
- ``personal`` — a personal access token (PAT, ``cs_pat_``) acting as the
  owning user across all of their workspaces (doc 08 §1.3). Managed by the
  owning user; the active workspace is resolved from ``X-Workspace-Id`` /
  last-active just like a session (doc 08 §1.4).

``next_cursor`` is ``None`` on the last page; otherwise it is the opaque

A normalized record emitted by ``normalize()`` (doc 16 §17.3).

D1 produces the skeleton (entity ref + extracted fields + provenance);
entity resolution and signal scoring are downstream tasks (doc 18 §2.4). D11
threads the degraded flag, the degraded field names, and any dead-letter
entries through so a downstream consumer sees the extraction was partial.

``correction`` is an optional suggested replacement (e.g. the correct email

DeadLetterEntry.title: DeadLetterEntry

A field (or document) that nothing could extract (doc 18 §2.3, §3.4).

Surfaced on the :class:`ExtractedDocument` and persisted to the
``recipes_dead_letter`` table by ``services.run_recipe`` so a failed

then replayed against the snapshot raw document (doc 18 §3.6).

DimensionLimitOut.title: DimensionLimitOut
DimensionLimitOut.description:
Limit-state for a single metering dimension (N4).

Extends N3's usage info with an explicit ``state`` field that the web
banner and enforcement dependency both read.

DimensionUsageOut.title: DimensionUsageOut
DimensionUsageOut.description:
Usage vs limit for a single metering dimension (N3).

``used`` is the counter for the current period.
``limit`` is the plan cap (``None`` = unlimited).
``pct_used`` is ``used / limit * 100`` rounded to one decimal, or
``None`` when the limit is unlimited.

FieldPreview.title: FieldPreview
FieldPreview.description:
Per-field diagnostic for a recipe authoring preview (doc 18 §3, §3.4).

Surfaces, for one declared field, what the dry-run extracted plus the
information an author needs to debug a miss: the ordered selector list that
*would* be tried, whether the field is required, and whether a required
field came back empty.

FoiaReminderConfigRead.description:
Current reminder configuration for a FOIA request (M5).

Returned by ``GET /api/v1/foia/requests/{id}/reminder`` and by the PATCH
endpoint after a successful update.

reminder_enabled.title: Reminder Enabled
reminder_enabled.description: Enable or disable reminders for this request.

reminder_days.title: Reminder Days
reminder_days.description: Days after sent_at before the first reminder fires.

FoiaReminderConfigUpdate.title: FoiaReminderConfigUpdate
FoiaReminderConfigUpdate.description:
PATCH body for ``PATCH /api/v1/foia/requests/{id}/reminder`` (M5).

All fields are optional; only supplied non-null values are applied.

``reminder_days`` and ``reminder_interval_days`` must be >= 1.
``reminder_max`` must be >= 0 (0 = unlimited).

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: Target agency / entity (must exist in directory).

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code (e.g. 'CA-PRA') to use for template-based body generation. Required when template_context is supplied.

template_context.title: Template Context
template_context.description: Placeholder values passed to render_template when jurisdiction is set. See the template's 'placeholders' list for required keys.

body.title: Body
body.description: Full request body text. If omitted, jurisdiction + template_context must be provided and the body is rendered from the template. If both body and jurisdiction/template_context are provided, body takes precedence.

submission_method.description: How the request will be physically submitted (default: manual).

submission_target.title: Submission Target
submission_target.description: Email address, portal URL, or mailing address for submission.

FoiaRequestCreate.title: FoiaRequestCreate
FoiaRequestCreate.description:
Request body for ``POST /api/v1/foia/requests`` (create a new request).

The request can be created in two ways:
1. **From a template** — supply ``jurisdiction`` and ``template_context``; the
   service will call ``render_template(jurisdiction, template_context)`` and
   use the result as ``body``.  If ``body`` is also supplied it takes
   precedence (useful for post-render edits before saving).
2. **Freeform** — supply ``body`` directly without ``jurisdiction``.

``entity_id`` is required: a FOIA request must always target a known agency
in the entity directory (C1). The entity is validated via
``entities.services.get_entity`` before the row is inserted.

FoiaRequestEventRead.title: FoiaRequestEventRead
FoiaRequestEventRead.description: One status-transition event in a FOIA request's history.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when this is the last page.

FoiaRequestRead.title: FoiaRequestRead
FoiaRequestRead.description:
A FOIA request as returned by the API.

Workspace-scoped — the caller's workspace is always the same as
``workspace_id``.

FoiaRequestStatus.title: FoiaRequestStatus
FoiaRequestStatus.description:
FOIA request lifecycle statuses (doc 07 §4, M2 task spec).

Allowed transitions (enforced by the service layer):
    draft → sent → ack → response

``draft`` is the only editable status; all other statuses are immutable
after transition (the ``update_request`` service raises
:exc:`FoiaDraftOnlyError` if the request is not ``draft``).

Note: the spec names the second state "sent" (manual-send MVP). The data
model doc 07 uses "submitted" for the same concept; we prefer "sent" here
to match the task brief and to avoid confusion with HTTP submission.

FoiaRequestTransition.title: FoiaRequestTransition
FoiaRequestTransition.description:
Request body for ``POST /api/v1/foia/requests/{id}/transition``.

``status`` is the *target* status.  Allowed paths:
    draft → sent → ack → response

Illegal transitions (e.g. draft → response) raise a 409
``foia_illegal_transition`` RFC 7807 error. ``response_notes`` is accepted
only when transitioning to ``response`` (ignored otherwise).

FoiaRequestUpdate.title: FoiaRequestUpdate
FoiaRequestUpdate.description:
Request body for ``PATCH /api/v1/foia/requests/{id}`` (draft-only edits).

All fields are optional; only supplied fields are updated.  Raises a 409
``foia_not_draft`` error if the request is not in ``draft`` status.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total number of templates in the library.

FoiaTemplateList.title: FoiaTemplateList
FoiaTemplateList.description:
All available FOIA templates returned as a single list (no pagination in M1).

M2 may add cursor pagination if the library grows beyond a few dozen entries.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter USPS state code; null for federal templates.

deadline_days.title: Deadline Days
deadline_days.description: Statutory response deadline in days (calendar or business — see deadline_note). 0 means no fixed statutory deadline.

deadline_note.title: Deadline Note
deadline_note.description: Plain-language explanation of how the deadline is counted and any extensions.

fee_waiver_language.title: Fee Waiver Language
fee_waiver_language.description: Boilerplate fee-waiver language for this jurisdiction.

submission_method_hint.title: Submission Method Hint
submission_method_hint.description: Common submission method(s) for this jurisdiction.

placeholders.title: Placeholders
placeholders.description: Caller-supplied placeholder keys the client must provide to render this template. Does NOT include template-owned tokens (e.g. 'fee_waiver_language') that are injected automatically from the template definition. Three entries are optional (requester_phone, requester_organization, records_officer_name) — all others are required.

FoiaTemplateRead.title: FoiaTemplateRead
FoiaTemplateRead.description:
A FOIA template as exposed on the public API.

All fields mirror the YAML schema (see foia/templates/README.md).
``status`` will always be ``"draft"`` in M1 — templates are pending
counsel review. Future releases may introduce ``"reviewed"`` status.

**Workspace scoping:** Templates are global reference data (shared across
all workspaces, analogous to :class:`recipes_recipe`). No ``workspace_id``
is present on this response. Authenticated requests are not required for
the list/get endpoints (treat them as public reference data), though the
application may choose to restrict access in production.

context.title: Context
context.description: Key-value map of placeholder values. Required placeholders (all entries in the template's 'placeholders' list except requester_phone, requester_organization, and records_officer_name) must be present and non-empty, or a 422 error is returned. Optional placeholders default to empty string when omitted. Template-owned tokens (e.g. fee_waiver_language) are injected automatically and must NOT be supplied here.

FoiaTemplateRenderRequest.title: FoiaTemplateRenderRequest
FoiaTemplateRenderRequest.description: Request body for the template render endpoint.

rendered_body.title: Rendered Body
rendered_body.description: Fully rendered request body, ready to send.

FoiaTemplateRenderResponse.title: FoiaTemplateRenderResponse
FoiaTemplateRenderResponse.description: Response from the template render endpoint.

IcpCreate.title: IcpCreate
IcpCreate.description:
Request body for ``POST /icp`` (doc 14 §3.1).

Most dimension arrays default to empty (= "all values", doc 14 §6.1); the
one exception is ``countries``, which defaults to ``["US"]`` (the MVP is
US-only, doc 14 §3.1). ``signal_types`` and ``entity_kinds`` are typed enums
so unknown values are rejected with ``422``.

IcpOut.title: IcpOut
IcpOut.description: Workspace-scoped public representation of an ICP definition.

IcpPage.title: IcpPage
IcpPage.description: A cursor-paginated page of ICP definitions (doc 06 §5, doc 08 §1.5).

IcpUpdate.title: IcpUpdate
IcpUpdate.description:
Partial patch for ``PATCH /icp/{id}``.

Every field is optional; ``None`` means "leave unchanged". ``is_active`` is
intentionally **not** patchable here — toggling activation goes through the
dedicated ``POST /icp/{id}/activate`` endpoint so the one-active-per-workspace
invariant is enforced atomically.

ItemMove.title: ItemMove
ItemMove.description:
Request body for ``POST /pipeline/items/{item_id}/move``.

J2 (Kanban DnD) calls this endpoint. Optionally updates ``status``
at the same time (e.g., moving to Won stage → status = won).

ItemOut.title: ItemOut
ItemOut.description: Public representation of a pipeline item.

ItemStatus.title: ItemStatus
ItemStatus.description:
Lifecycle status for a pipeline item (J1, PRD F14).

``active`` is the working state; ``archived`` hides the item from the
default Kanban view without deleting it so J5 reporting can still count it.
``won`` / ``lost`` / ``disqualified`` are terminal outcomes that correspond
to the final-column stages but are tracked explicitly so J5 can roll them up
across stage renamings.

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: accounts_member.id; omit to leave unchanged, send null to un-assign.

LimitState.title: LimitState
LimitState.description:
Per-dimension usage state for N4 enforcement.

ok        — usage < 80% of the plan cap (or the dimension is unlimited).
warning   — usage is >= 80% but < 100% (soft banner should be shown).
exceeded  — usage is >= 100% (hard 429 enforcement; paywall CTA).

MemberPage.title: MemberPage
MemberPage.description: A cursor-paginated page of workspace members (doc 06 §5, doc 08 §1.5).

MemberRoleUpdate.title: MemberRoleUpdate
MemberRoleUpdate.description:
Request body for ``PATCH /workspaces/{id}/members/{user_id}`` — set a role.

``owner`` is intentionally not assignable here: ownership is a single seat set
at creation and transferred via a dedicated (later) flow, not by a generic
role change. Admins manage ``admin``/``member``/``viewer``.

MembershipRole.title: MembershipRole
MembershipRole.description:
Role a user holds in a workspace (doc 07 §2 ``accounts_member.role``).

The column exists from B5 so RBAC (B7) has somewhere to enforce against;
B5 itself only distinguishes the workspace creator (``owner``) from invited
members (default ``member``). Enforcement of role-gated actions is deferred
to B7.

PasswordResetConfirmBody.title: PasswordResetConfirmBody
PasswordResetConfirmBody.description:
Body for POST /auth/password-reset/confirm.

``token`` is the opaque URL-safe token from the reset email. ``new_password``
is validated against the same policy as signup (B1) so users can't set a
trivially weak password via the reset path.

PasswordResetRequestBody.title: PasswordResetRequestBody
PasswordResetRequestBody.description:
Body for POST /auth/password-reset/request.

Only the email is required; the response is ALWAYS 204 to prevent user
enumeration (doc 08 §3.1, threat-model §4.2).

PipelineReport.title: PipelineReport
PipelineReport.description:
Workspace-level pipeline rollup (J5, ``GET /pipeline/report``).

``stages``       — per-stage counts and summed value, ordered by position.
``total_items``  — total item count across all stages.
``total_value``  — summed value across all stages; ``None`` if no values set.

PlanLimitsOut.title: PlanLimitsOut
PlanLimitsOut.description:
Serializable limits map for a plan (N2).

``None`` means unlimited for that dimension.

PlanOut.title: PlanOut
PlanOut.description:
Full plan definition response (N2).

Returned by ``GET /billing/plan`` so the frontend and SDKs can render
upgrade CTAs and enforce soft limits client-side.

PreviewRequest.title: PreviewRequest
PreviewRequest.description:
Staff preview request: a recipe (id or inline YAML) + a sample input.

Exactly one of ``recipe_id`` / ``recipe_yaml`` identifies the recipe, and
exactly one of ``html`` / ``url`` supplies the sample input. The endpoint
validates the one-of constraints and returns RFC 7807 problems otherwise.

PreviewResult.title: PreviewResult
PreviewResult.description:
Result of dry-running a recipe against a sample input (doc 18 §3).

Captures a required-field failure into ``error`` (with ``ok = False``)
rather than raising, so the authoring UI/CLI can render the partial result
— a failed extraction is exactly what an author needs to iterate on.

RewriteRequest.title: RewriteRequest
RewriteRequest.description:
``POST /smart-search/rewrite`` request body.

``query`` is whitespace-stripped before length validation so a blank/whitespace
-only body is rejected with a 422 rather than silently producing an empty
rewrite. ``max_length`` guards the upstream prompt size.

RewriteUsage.title: RewriteUsage
RewriteUsage.description: Token usage + model provenance for one rewrite call (doc 06 §7 accounting).

SearchFilters.title: SearchFilters
SearchFilters.description:
Structured filters aligned with the ``GET /signals`` feed params (doc 08 §3.2).

Every field is optional: the rewrite only sets a filter it is confident the NL
query implied. Repeatable params are lists (treated as ``IN (...)``, doc 08 §1.6).
``extra="forbid"`` makes the schema strict so an LLM that invents a field is
rejected and routed through repair/fallback rather than silently accepted.

SignalRead.title: SignalRead
SignalRead.description:
A persisted ``signals_signal`` row, the read shape returned by the API.

The canonical global signal (doc 07 §2 "signals"). ``details`` is the validated
per-type payload (the ``details_jsonb`` column); the lifted columns
(``occurred_at``, ``amount_cents`` via the payload, …) are also present on the
row. Workspace-specific scoring lives in ``signals_workspace_score`` (F3), never
here — the signal is global (doc 07 §3, doc 14 §4.2).

SignalType.title: SignalType
SignalType.description:
Signal types the system produces (doc 08 §3.2, §4 OpenAPI ``Signal.enum``).

Used both for the ICP's ``signal_types`` (pre-filter) and as the allowed keys
of the ``signal_weights`` map (scorer). Kept as the single source of truth for
ICP validation; extending the catalogue is an additive, non-breaking change
(doc 08 §1.2).

SignupResponse.title: SignupResponse
SignupResponse.description:
Signup response — the new user plus tokens. ``email_verification_required``
tells the client whether login is gated on verifying the email first.

StageOut.title: StageOut
StageOut.description: Public representation of a pipeline stage.

StageReorder.title: StageReorder
StageReorder.description:
Request body for ``PUT /pipeline/stages/reorder``.

The caller supplies the full ordered list of stage ids; the server
rebuilds positions 0..N-1 in that order. All stage ids must belong to the
workspace; any missing stage id is an error.

StageReorderItem.title: StageReorderItem
StageReorderItem.description: One entry in the reorder payload — stage id + desired position.

StageRollup.title: StageRollup
StageRollup.description:
Per-stage totals in the pipeline rollup report (J5).

``item_count`` — number of items currently in this stage.
``total_value`` — sum of all non-null ``value_estimate`` values (USD, 2dp).
                  ``None`` when no items have a value estimate.

StructuredQuery.title: StructuredQuery
StructuredQuery.description:
The full NL -> structured rewrite result.

``filters`` carry everything the feed/hybrid retrieval can pin down; ``text``
is the residual free-text the rewrite could not turn into a filter, fed to
full-text/semantic search (TODO I3). ``keywords`` are salient terms the model
surfaced (kept distinct from ``text`` for optional BM25 boosting). ``entities``
are free-text entity/geography *hints* (e.g. "Northshore School District")
that I3's entity resolution will map to ``entity_id``\ s — we do not invent
ids here. ``degraded`` is set when the LLM rewrite failed and we fell back to
treating the whole input as the text query.

SubmissionMethod.title: SubmissionMethod
SubmissionMethod.description:
Physical method used to submit the FOIA request (doc 07 §2 foia_request).

``manual`` covers the MVP case where the user copies and sends the rendered
body themselves. ``email`` / ``portal`` / ``mail`` / ``in_person`` are the
canonical future options when CivicSignals can automate / pre-fill the send.

SubscriptionPlan.title: SubscriptionPlan
SubscriptionPlan.description:
Plans available in the system (doc 07 §2, PRD F15).

# TODO N2: replace/extend with a richer billing_plan table (price IDs, feature
#   flags, seat limits) once plan definitions land.

SubscriptionStatus.title: SubscriptionStatus
SubscriptionStatus.description:
Lifecycle states for a workspace subscription (doc 07 §4 Subscription).

``trialing → active → past_due → read_only → suspended → cancelled``

TokenPair.title: TokenPair
TokenPair.description: Bearer access (+refresh) JWTs returned by signup/login (doc 08 §1.3).

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description: Public representation of a user (doc 08 §3.1 ``user`` object).

WorkspaceCreate.title: WorkspaceCreate
WorkspaceCreate.description:
Request body for ``POST /workspaces`` (doc 08 §2 ``/workspaces``).

``slug`` is optional — when omitted the server derives a unique one from the
name. ``country_default`` is the workspace's default jurisdiction (doc 07).

WorkspaceLimitsOut.title: WorkspaceLimitsOut
WorkspaceLimitsOut.description:
Per-dimension limit states for the workspace (N4).

Returned by ``GET /billing/limits``.  Clients drive the soft-limit
banner (warning ≥ 80%) and paywall CTA (exceeded ≥ 100%) from this.

WorkspaceOut.title: WorkspaceOut
WorkspaceOut.description:
Public representation of a workspace.

``role`` is the requesting user's role in this workspace (doc 08 §3.1
``workspaces[].role``); it is populated from the caller's membership and is
``None`` only when the workspace is returned outside a membership context.

WorkspacePage.title: WorkspacePage
WorkspacePage.description:
A cursor-paginated page of workspaces (doc 06 §5, doc 08 §1.5).

``next_cursor`` is ``None`` on the last page; otherwise it is the opaque
token the client passes back as ``?cursor=…`` to fetch the next page.

WorkspacePlanOut.title: WorkspacePlanOut
WorkspacePlanOut.description:
Effective plan for the current workspace (N2).

``GET /billing/plan`` response — the plan the workspace is *currently on*,
resolved by ``billing.services.get_workspace_plan``.  Includes the full
limits + features so clients have a single call for all gating decisions.

WorkspaceUsageOut.title: WorkspaceUsageOut
WorkspaceUsageOut.description:
Current-period usage vs plan limits for the workspace (N3).

Returned by ``GET /billing/usage``.  The ``period`` is the billing month
in ``YYYY-MM`` format (calendar month, UTC).  ``dimensions`` is a mapping
of :class:`Dimension` value → :class:`DimensionUsageOut` so clients can
look up any dimension by name without position-coupling.
